text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $84.5K with minimal movement, while Ethereum has underperformed with a 1.3% decline, suggesting modest risk-off sentiment in alts despite the broader market remaining in greed territory. BTC dominance at 58.8% and elevated volume of $122B indicate traders are rotating into or holding Bitcoin as a relative safe haven rather than chasing alternative assets. The Fear & Greed index at 72 reflects confidence, but Ethereum's weakness hints that conviction in the secondary layer is weaker than headline sentiment alone would suggest.
